summary.text: Tai Bai blessed land is Tai Bai Yun Sheng's high grade time path immortal aperture, rich in time path dao marks and poor in earth path marks.

claims.text: Tai Bai Yun Sheng describes his Tai Bai blessed land as most numerous in time path dao marks, so time based resources are abundant: one day in the outside world is thirty-three days inside. It has the least earth path dao marks, so there are no mountains and the soil is infertile. Space path dao marks are only ordinary: the area is not large, but the sky is very high.

When Fang Yuan visits alongside Tai Bai Yun Sheng, the narration seats Tai Bai blessed land in Northern Plains. It is a high grade blessed land of about four thousand seven hundred square kilometers with many time path resources. After the blessed land is placed to absorb outside heaven and earth qi and connects to Northern Plains, the time flow slows to twelve days inside per day outside. Tai Bai Yun Sheng manages it well: float ball tea, jade peak bird groups, sky chief clouds with flowers, and sparrowhawks moving among them. Float ball tea is a second revenue source; each season the land produces a huge quantity of float ball tea grass.
Tens of thousands of feathermen appear inside Tai Bai blessed land as a living earthly calamity.

If featherman Gu Immortals die inside that aperture, their immortal apertures fall into Tai Bai blessed land and cannot separate; the outside world there is the blessed land itself, so their dao marks fuse into Tai Bai’s land under his control of heaven and earth qi.
The featherman Gu Immortals’ tribulation fight plays out inside Tai Bai blessed land, and Tai Bai Yun Sheng receives their dao marks after the calamity passes.
